name: rum
description: With Amazon CloudWatch RUM, you can perform real-user monitoring to collect client-side data about your web application performance from actual user sessions in real time.

subcommands.name: batch-create-rum-metric-definitions
subcommands.description: Specifies the extended metrics and custom metrics that you want a CloudWatch RUM app monitor to send to a destination.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-rum-metric-definitions
subcommands.description: Removes the specified metrics from being sent to an extended metrics destination.

subcommands.name: batch-get-rum-metric-definitions
subcommands.description: Retrieves the list of metrics and dimensions that a RUM app monitor is sending to a single destination.

subcommands.name: create-app-monitor
subcommands.description: Creates a Amazon CloudWatch RUM app monitor, which collects telemetry data from your application and sends that data to RUM.

subcommands.name: delete-app-monitor
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing app monitor.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Removes the association of a resource-based policy from an app monitor.

subcommands.name: delete-rum-metrics-destination
subcommands.description: Deletes a destination for CloudWatch RUM extended metrics, so that the specified app monitor stops sending extended metrics to that destination.

subcommands.name: get-app-monitor
subcommands.description: Retrieves the complete configuration information for one app monitor.

subcommands.name: get-app-monitor-data
subcommands.description: Retrieves the raw performance events that RUM has collected from your web application, so that you can do your own processing or analysis of this data.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Use this operation to retrieve information about a resource-based policy that is attached to an app monitor.

subcommands.name: list-app-monitors
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the Amazon CloudWatch RUM app monitors in the account.

subcommands.name: list-rum-metrics-destinations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of destinations that you have created to receive RUM extended metrics, for the specified app monitor.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Displays the tags associated with a CloudWatch RUM resource.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Use this operation to assign a resource-based policy to a CloudWatch RUM app monitor to control access to it.

subcommands.name: put-rum-events
subcommands.description: Sends telemetry events about your application performance and user behavior to CloudWatch RUM.

subcommands.name: put-rum-metrics-destination
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a destination to receive extended metrics from CloudWatch RUM.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns one or more tags (key-value pairs) to the specified CloudWatch RUM resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-app-monitor
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of an existing app monitor.

subcommands.name: update-rum-metric-definition
subcommands.description: Modifies one existing metric definition for CloudWatch RUM extended metrics.
